description: Read a run: status, output, error, cost and billing_pending. COST: while billing_pending is true (or the run is still going), cost_micros is PROVISIONAL and usually higher than the final cost; the result then has cost_final:false and a cost_note. Quote a cost only when cost_final is true (the run is finished and billing_pending is false); otherwise call get_run again in a few seconds. For a zero-data-retention run the first read of a finished run returns the output and then deletes it. On the hosted service a run costs a run fee once its worker starts, compute per second, model calls at the provider's price plus a percentage, and web requests and searches at flat prices; `GET /v1/me` reports the rates.

id.description: The run's id, as returned by create_run.
